concepts.name: GM
concepts.definition: The person who owns a Group and picks its Sessions. A GM is a signed-in user, either an Anonymous GM or an Account.

concepts.name: Anonymous GM
concepts.definition: A GM created by the one click on "Create your link", with no email and no password. An Anonymous GM exists only while it owns at least one Group.

concepts.name: Account
concepts.definition: A signed-in user who can sign in again on any device. One Account can be a GM, a Player, or both: it owns Groups and claims Players.

concepts.name: Player
concepts.definition: A name on a Group's Roster. A Player needs no Account; whoever holds the Share Link can answer as any Player.

concepts.name: Claimed Player
concepts.definition: A Player linked to an Account, so the Account opens the Group as that Player on any device. An Account claims at most one Player per Group. A claim adds no protection.

concepts.name: Claim
concepts.definition: Linking a Player to the signed-in Account. Distinct from the Save claim code, which moves an Anonymous GM's Groups.

concepts.name: Release
concepts.definition: Undoing a Claim. Releasing never deletes the Player.

concepts.name: My groups
concepts.definition: The Account's page (/me): the Groups it runs and the Groups where it has a Claimed Player, each with its upcoming Sessions.

concepts.name: Group
concepts.definition: One table of people who play together: one GM, a Roster, Answers, and Sessions.

concepts.name: Roster
concepts.definition: The Players of one Group.

concepts.name: Share Link
concepts.definition: The URL next-session.link/s/<Share Token> that opens a Group's player surface. It is the only credential a Player needs.

concepts.name: Share Token
concepts.definition: The unguessable part of the Share Link. Rotating it gives the Group a new Share Link and stops the old one.

concepts.name: Unsaved Group
concepts.definition: A Group owned by an Anonymous GM. It expires after 30 days without activity.

concepts.name: Save
concepts.definition: Moving every Group of an Anonymous GM to an Account. The Share Link stays the same, and an Account's existing Groups are never touched.

concepts.name: Expiry
concepts.definition: The moment an Unsaved Group is deleted for inactivity. Any GM or Player activity on the Group pushes it out again.

concepts.name: Answer
concepts.definition: One Player's reply for one date: free, maybe, or busy. A date without an Answer is unanswered.

concepts.name: Booking Window
concepts.definition: The dates that can be answered or scheduled: from today to the end of the month two months after the current one.

concepts.name: Session
concepts.definition: A date the GM picked for the Group to play. A Group has at most one Session per date.

concepts.name: Best Nights
concepts.definition: The top three dates of the visible month that no Player answered busy, ranked by how many are free, with maybe counting half.

concepts.name: Fill Rest
concepts.definition: A Player's action that answers busy for every unanswered date left in the month.

concepts.name: Legal Acceptance
concepts.definition: The record that a GM agreed to the Terms and the Privacy Policy: both document versions and a timestamp.

concepts.name: Welcome Mail
concepts.definition: The one email every new Account gets right after it is created, confirming the Account and linking My groups.

concepts.name: Session updates
concepts.definition: Emails to the Accounts behind a Group's Claimed Players when a Session is set or cancelled, excluding the actor.

concepts.name: Tips
concepts.definition: Two short emails on getting the first game night scheduled, sent only to an Account that opted in twice.

concepts.name: Product Marker
concepts.definition: The product: "next-session" property on every event, exception and log Next Session sends to PostHog.

concepts.name: Terms
concepts.definition: The Next Session Terms of Service a GM accepts, drafted in docs/legal/terms.md.

concepts.name: Privacy Policy
concepts.definition: The Next Session Privacy Policy a GM accepts, drafted in docs/legal/privacy.md.

concepts.name: Cancelled Session
concepts.definition: A Session the GM called off after its Undo window. It stays on its date marked Cancelled, never counts as played, and Schedule again restores the same Session until the date passes.
